title_sq: SHITET AMBIENT KOMERCIAL TE ISH EKSPOZITA!
description_sq:
Ne nje nga zonat me elitare te Tiranes te ish ekspozita ofrojme per shitje ambient biznesi ne -1. Pozicionohet ne rruge kryesore dhe ka vizibilitet maksimal. Ambienti eshte 100.5m2 siperfaqje e brendshme dhe 117.5m2 totale, ka dy tualete. Sapo eshte dhene me qira 3 vjecare 1300 euro ne muaj neto, gje qe e ben nje mundesi te mire edhe per investim.
Nuk ka hipoteke.
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
description_en: In one of the most elite areas of Tirana, a former exhibition, we offer for sale business premises at -1. It is positioned on the main road and has maximum visibility. The environment is 100.5m2 internal surface and 117.5m2 total, there are two toilets. It has just been leased for 3 years for 1300 euros per month, which makes it a good investment opportunity. There is no mortgage. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
